description:
LANDED 41906b046 (2026-09-01; refuter FIX-THEN-MERGE, two doc-only
sentence corrections folded; gate lib 1540/0/5, cli 24/0, matrix
440/0/9). The generalization-at-minting cure was REFUTED BY PROTOTYPE
first (7 fixture breaks + 16 lib gates; the generalized key is
post-walk but the walk resolved against precise keys; monotonicity
premise false -- fanout is a branch join inside ONE row) -- do not
re-propose it; Design I (this) won on the runtime-representation
evidence.

THE AXIS, full-stack: RuntimeTypePredicate.callables:
FiniteSet<ClosureTarget> (replacing closures:bool);
runtime_type_test_envelope keeps closure FN IDS (erases
args/ret/captures) -- the deletion of the 'callable correlation is
runtime-unobservable' policy, whose refutation is the runtime layout
itself (heap +8 = code ptr; native one-boundary-per-FnId fn_addr;
interp slot holds FnId); interp reads identity back through a
CallableIdentities resolver (incl. construction-wrapper synthetic id
0x8000_0000|identity translation); native emits closure-tag-guarded
closure_code_ref vs fn_addr OR-reduced over every minting boundary
(refuter: empty-address-list tripwire fired 0x over 582 fixtures x2
doors; boundaries are Linkage::Local w/ distinct relocations, no ICF
in the link line -- no aliasing). ABI: the real defect was
encode_runtime_value's silent lanes.push(*var) (caller's closure word
as callee capture lane, past the count check) -- encoder now TOTAL;
caller-side unpack via new Prim::ClosureCapture with the repr from
the boundary that STORED the capture. DispatchAlternative deleted
(~80 lines) for the shared question_groups helper (the kdt.107 F5
fold).

FIXES (12 probes, 3 paths, refuter-re-verified incl. list/tuple/map
carriers, MakeFnRef fnrefs, multi-clause wrapper translation): the
8-line Pipeline repro 12/12->12/90; fz-kdt.126's q2join
12 90 90 12 -> 12 90 12 90; the captures-variant native abort ->
correct; three-lambda all-first -> each its own. Both new fixtures
carry byte-matching Elixir oracles. 582x3-door sweep: 0 movers, AOT
build-failure set identical. Red-verified: restoring the one fun_top
flatten line turns 8 lib gates red + both fixtures wrong on all doors.

CLASSIFIED MOVEMENT: canon 8 movers -- 6 plan-only (+11/-2, one
identity test each), 2 plan+ONE regained executable each
(inventory 203->204 re-pinned w/ cause: the arm fz-kdt.118 dropped is
no longer indistinguishable and its specialization stops being dead --
fz-kdt.123's predicted arms-become-LIVE resolution). No pre-existing
key/demand/transport line changed.

DEVIATIONS/RESIDUE (all flagged, all owned): spec item 6's backstop
NOT built -- its premise was refuted (the review census regexed
CAPTURES as identity; true residue 13->6 no-question groups on 5
fixtures, ALL same-fn-id/different-capture = fz-kdt.127's shape; a
diagnostic would refuse 5 working fixtures; residue pinned by
compiler2_runtime_indistinguishable_arm_residue_stays_pinned; refuter
probed 5 non-interchangeability attacks, all correct -- the residue
members are genuinely interchangeable today). FIFO/LIFO dump movers
3->4: the regained predicate-lens arm pair (distinguishable, nested)
swaps by arrival order -- precision never meaning, corpus stdout
FIFO==LIFO 0/582x3 -- fz-kdt.129 owns the specificity ordering; both
lens-doc sentences restated to the surviving truth (counts
schedule-independent; bytes except that one dispatch). fz-kdt.128
landed in measured form (encoder totality + lower_closure_capture
refusal; the declarative arm-assert priced and rejected -- reprs are
decided in codegen; O1: the refusal's trigger is still unconstructed,
red-first test wanted; O2: ClosureCapture's three-table index
correspondence deserves a debug_assert on lane-vs-repr count).
REFUTER BYCATCH (pre-existing, both revisions): two P1 mailbox
parity breaks filed as fz-kdt.130 (closure through receive: JIT/AOT
invoke once for twice / print nothing for a direct invoke).

comments.text:
BUILT (2026-09-01, one commit off bd03d922e). Spec items 1-5, 7 and 8 landed;
item 6 (the unrepresentable-plan BACKSTOP) did NOT, and the reason is a refuted
premise rather than a deferral -- see the fz-kdt.127 comment: the corpus fallout
of the diagnostic is six inseparable groups across five fixtures, not zero, so
emitting it would refuse to compile 00231, 00277, 00281, opaque_fn_value_join
and repr_seam_enum_count_after_reduce2. The census helper's "13/13 separable by
fn id" counted closure names appearing in CAPTURES as identity; the true split
is 7 separable, 6 not.

CLASSIFICATION, whole corpus base vs head (`fz2 interp --dump backend`, 580
fixtures, spans normalized): 8 dumps move. Six move by PLAN ONLY, +11/-2 lines
each -- one dispatch gaining a callable-identity test. Two (enum_predicate_search,
enum_reduce_halt_arm_order) gain ONE executable each and every key/demand/lane
line they add is that executable's own; nothing pre-existing changed text. Both
are arms fz-kdt.118 dropped as runtime-indistinguishable that are not
indistinguishable any more. `backend_inventory_width_stays_pinned_on_the_target_
fixtures` re-pinned 203 -> 204 with that cause recorded.

Corpus stdout and exit codes: 0 movers, base vs head, and 0 movers FIFO vs LIFO
at head. FIFO-vs-LIFO backend dumps: 3 differing fixtures at base, 4 at head --
fz-kdt.129 owns the fourth.

RECORD CORRECTION (fz-kdt.127.1, commit f34c2aaa3). Two claims in this
ticket's landing record were true of the axis it built and are false of
the axis that stands now.

1. "native one-boundary-per-FnId fn_addr". There was never one boundary
   per FnId -- a callable minted at several capture layouts has one
   boundary per construction position -- and the reader that pretended
   otherwise, `callable_boundaries_for_target`, ORed every boundary of a
   function into one address list. It is deleted. A test now names
   CONSTRUCTIONS, and codegen picks the boundaries whose own shape the
   test enumerates (`callable_boundaries_enumerated_by`).

2. "runtime_type_test_envelope keeps closure FN IDS (erases
   args/ret/captures)". The captures are kept now, at every depth, each
   enveloped by the same reading. `RuntimeTypePredicate.callables` is a
   `CallableShapes` container (fz-kdt.119's `TupleShapes` twin), its
   precision row is per-position, and admission of a value is CONTAINMENT
   of its construction shape in the arm's, never overlap (fz-kdt.167).
   The `FiniteSet<ClosureTarget>` element and the
   `Fn(u64) -> Option<ClosureTarget>` resolver signature are gone.

Also settled from this ticket's residue: the pin
`compiler2_runtime_indistinguishable_arm_residue_stays_pinned` (6 groups
over 5 fixtures, all same-fn-id/different-capture) is DELETED, and its
five fixtures -- 00231, 00277, 00281, opaque_fn_value_join,
repr_seam_enum_count_after_reduce2 -- are now entries in
`compiler2_dispatch_offers_no_runtime_indistinguishable_arm`. The corpus
census of arm pairs no runtime question separates is empty.
